items.quote: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
items.claim: Moses stretched his rod toward heaven, and the Lord sent thunder, hail, and fire upon Egypt
items.action: stretched forth his rod; sent thunder and hail; rained hail
